sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Arlon Graphics manufactures cast and calendered vinyl films for the wide-format graphics industry.

Industry: Materials Manufacturing · HQ: Southern California, United States · Size: not published · Products: Cast Vinyl Films, Calendered Vinyl Films, Fleet and Vehicle Wraps, Wall Wraps, Promotional Media, SLX+ Cast Film

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Arlon Graphics scores 47 of 100 (tier C) at 85% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (24/30) and event engagement (15/15). Nothing was found for company size and pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (60% similar on films, vinyl, graphics, vehicle); Mactac (48% similar on films, vinyl, graphic, graphics); ORAFOL Europe (42% similar on films, graphic, graphics, africa). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Company size: Any published revenue or headcount would unlock up to 15 points.
• Pain-point alignment: Each additional durability theme found adds 5 points.
• Flags on the record: size unknown
